Our Story

A Love Worth Celebrating

What began as an unexpected encounter blossomed into something rare and enduring — a love built on trust, shared dreams, and an unwavering commitment to each other. Through every season, Jonathan and Aliah have chosen one another, time and again, discovering depths of devotion they never knew possible.

Now, as they stand at the threshold of a new chapter, they wish for nothing more than to share this sacred moment with those they hold dearest. Your presence would mean everything to them.
